My place is 129 mu — that is a big piece of ground for just 2 of us in the house, so my kids help at busy times and I hire a few hands for the wheat cutting and maize picking. The tractor and combine I rent from the village service.

This year I plan the same way as last year, because last year was not bad. Most of my land, about 80 mu, I keep in the wheat-maize rotation — that is what works here in Quzhou, everyone does it. I have 30 mu on the sandier plot where cotton does better, and 19 mu on the corner where I put millet because that ground is thin and maize does not fill there.

For wheat: I sow in early October, improved variety from the seed station — Jimai type, same as my neighbor Old Wang uses, he got over 500 kg last year. I plough before sowing because wheat likes a loose bed. I apply compound fertilizer as base — about 50 kg/mu of 15-15-15, then 15 kg/mu urea at jointing. That gives me roughly 15 kg N, 7 kg P, 7 kg K per mu. I irrigate 4 times — before winter, at green-up, jointing, and grain-filling. Well water, so I control it myself. Pesticide 3 times — one for weeds in spring, one for aphids and powdery mildew, one for the bug at heading.

For maize after wheat: hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu type. No-tillage direct seeding right after wheat harvest, no time to plough in June. I put 40 kg/mu of compound at sowing plus 20 kg urea at big trumpet stage — about 17 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. Irrigate twice if the rain is poor. Spray twice — one for armyworm, one for borer.

Cotton is more work and more expensive. Bt cotton seed because the bollworm was bad before Bt came. I plough deep in spring, apply 40 kg compound plus 15 kg urea and 10 kg potassium sulfate — cotton eats a lot of potassium. Irrigate 3 times. Pesticide many times, 7 or 8, because aphids, spider mites, and plant bugs still come.

Millet I keep traditional — local variety, low input. 10 kg urea and one bag of compound, rotary till, one irrigation if dry, spray once for worms. Yield is not high but the grain sells well and the straw feeds animals.
